boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct University of San Diego study environments, ranging from silent reading rooms to reservable collaboration spaces.

cards.title: Mother Rosalie Hill Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Copley Library upper level · silent study
cards.notes: Bring work that needs complete concentration; this is Copley’s absolute-quiet room, where talking is not permitted.
cards.short_summary: A designated silent-study room in Copley Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Copley’s quiet policy reserves the Mother Hill Reading Room for absolute quiet study and prohibits talking there.
cards.access_notes: Located on Copley Library’s upper level; follow the library’s absolute-quiet policy.

cards.title: Journals Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Copley Library upper level · quiet study
cards.notes: Settle in with reading or writing work and keep conversation brief; this upper-level room is part of the quiet-study area.
cards.short_summary: A named upper-level reading room within Copley’s quiet-study floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Copley lists the Journals Reading Room on its upper level, and its quiet policy identifies it as part of the Scholarly Living Room for quiet study.
cards.access_notes: Not reservable; Copley says this room is not intended for classes or organizational meetings.

cards.entity_name: Faculty and Graduate Student Reading Room
cards.title: Faculty and Graduate Student Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Copley Library upper level
cards.notes: Use this reading room for quiet academic work if you meet its intended audience; do not plan a class or organization meeting here.
cards.short_summary: An upper-level Copley reading room intended for faculty and graduate students.
cards.evidence_claim: Copley lists a Faculty and Graduate Student Reading Room on the upper level; its policy says the Faculty Reading Room is not reservable or intended for class or organizational meetings.
cards.access_notes: Upper-level Copley space; it is not available for reservation.

cards.title: Garden Study Room
cards.subtitle: Copley Library upper level · quiet study
cards.notes: Choose this named room when you want a quiet setting for individual reading or laptop work, keeping extended conversation elsewhere.
cards.short_summary: A named study room in Copley’s quiet upper-level area.
cards.evidence_claim: Copley’s renovation information names the Garden Study Room, and its quiet policy includes it in the second-floor Scholarly Living Room intended for quiet study.
cards.access_notes: Part of Copley’s second-floor quiet-study area; extended conversations are not appropriate.

cards.title: Copley Lounge
cards.subtitle: Copley Library lower level · collaborative work
cards.notes: Bring a partner or project that benefits from discussion; Copley allows extended conversation and collaboration in this lounge.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level library lounge for collaborative academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: Copley lists Copley Lounge on the lower level, and its quiet policy permits extended conversations and collaboration there.
cards.access_notes: Use moderate-volume conversation; loud talking is not appropriate anywhere in Copley Library.

cards.title: Camino Stacks Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Copley Library lower level
cards.notes: Head to the Camino Stacks when you need open seating for work that can tolerate the library’s lower-level conversation policy.
cards.short_summary: Named study seating in Copley Library’s Camino Stacks.
cards.evidence_claim: Copley lists study spaces in the Camino Stacks on the lower level and permits online meetings in Camino Stacks seating under its quiet policy.
cards.access_notes: Lower-level library area; moderate talking is allowed, while loud talking is not.

cards.title: Individual Study Rooms 223–226
cards.subtitle: Copley Library upper level · reservation required
cards.notes: Reserve one of rooms 223–226 for solo work; book in hourly increments and check in promptly to keep the reservation.
cards.short_summary: Four reservable Copley rooms designated for individual study.
cards.evidence_claim: Copley’s policy identifies rooms 223–226 as individual study rooms available to current USD students, with reservation limits.
cards.access_notes: Current USD students may reserve; bookings are hourly, up to two hours each, and require check-in.

cards.title: Copley Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Copley Library · reservation required
cards.notes: Reserve with at least one collaborator for an academic project; use the room’s whiteboard and AirMedia connection for shared work.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms equipped for group study and collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: Copley has 25 reservable group study rooms for undergraduate and graduate students; its rooms have whiteboards and AirMedia players.
cards.source_title: Group Study Room Information — Copley Library
cards.access_notes: For current USD students and group reservations only; minimum occupancy is two and reservations require check-in.

cards.title: Seminar Room 122
cards.subtitle: Copley Library lower level · group reservation
cards.notes: Book this larger seminar room for a substantial group session; plan for six or more people and bring collaborative coursework.
cards.short_summary: A reservable lower-level seminar room for larger academic groups.
cards.evidence_claim: Copley’s policy identifies Seminar Room 122 as reservable for current USD students, faculty and staff, with a six-person minimum and 14-person maximum.
cards.access_notes: Reservation required; room 122 is limited to groups of 6–14 and two-hour bookings.

cards.title: Learning Commons Town Square
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons · informal gathering space
cards.notes: Use the stadium-style seating for independent work between classes, or coordinate a small-group session around the flexible learning setting.
cards.short_summary: A central informal space in USD’s Learning Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: USD describes the Learning Commons Town Square as an informal gathering space with stadium seating for up to 200 people; the building includes collaborative study spaces and supports group and individual study.
cards.source_title: Learning Commons — University of San Diego
cards.access_notes: An informal Learning Commons space; confirm any event setup or availability before planning a group meeting.
